approvalRequired.label: Use full Public API

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Single-document reads and non-persistent word searches run directly; uploads and every broader or mutating API operation require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected API-key-authorized Archbee operation runs without Relay per-action approval; ownership, fixed origin, bounds, audits, redaction, and provider authority still apply.

providerSetup.nextAction: A customer creates or copies a DocSpace API key, enters both values, then Relay runs health, bounded reads, Safe denial plus approval, and Dangerous-mode mutation.

evidence.supports: Archbee documents customer-owned API-key setup, base64 bearer construction from DocSpace ID and API key, and its Public API.

The official OpenAPI 3 specification publishes 17 fixed-origin paths for documents, search, imports, spaces, groups, publishing, API references, suggested changes, organization export and rules, and uploads.
The documented search operation supports word, AI chat, and AI retrieval modes; Relay's Safe wrapper fixes non-persistent word search.
